summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all ten paragraphs of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the conditions, negations, reciprocal work, wage imagery, souls reading, closing promise, and selected singular understanding/service ending. Editorial insertions, conjectures, supplied letters, and reported witness differences are disclosed rather than presented as uniformly preserved text. The simplified edition’s sustenance interpretation in paragraph 6 is contextually defensible and explicitly distinguished from the literal wording and alternative interpretation. Acceptance is limited to source fidelity and consistency with the supplied project reports; it does not authenticate unseen images or editions, certify exhaustive collation, or establish a unique interpretation.
